s07F252.name: Set score value from height and give points
summary: Called from bank 01 ($01:C11F) after a sprite stores a height value in [$1594,X].
Looks up [$1594,X]/4 in the score-value table at $07F1AA, stores it in $1900 and, if the value is $50, awards points ($0A).
Purpose is not fully certain; the exact use of $1900 was not traced.

Sprite1656Vals.name: Table: sprite tweaker $1656 by sprite number
summary: One byte per sprite number $00-$C8; copied into RAM_Tweaker1656,X by LoadTweakerBytes.
Per-sprite object interaction / clipping property flags.

Sprite1662Vals.name: Table: sprite tweaker $1662 by sprite number
summary: One byte per sprite number $00-$C8; copied into RAM_Tweaker1662,X. Low bits select the sprite clipping (hitbox) shape; upper bits are behaviour flags.

Sprite166EVals.name: Table: sprite tweaker $166E by sprite number
summary: One byte per sprite number $00-$C8; copied into RAM_Tweaker166E,X. Low nibble = palette (bits 1-3) and graphics page (bit 0),
also loaded into RAM_SpritePal by LoadSpriteTables; upper bits are interaction flags (fireball, cape, water splash...).

Sprite167AVals.name: Table: sprite tweaker $167A by sprite number
summary: One byte per sprite number $00-$C8; copied into RAM_Tweaker167A,X. Behaviour flags (e.g. processing off screen, star/Yoshi interaction).

Sprite1686Vals.name: Table: sprite tweaker $1686 by sprite number
summary: One byte per sprite number $00-$C8; copied into RAM_Tweaker1686,X. Behaviour/inedible/sprite-interaction flags.

Sprite190FVals.name: Table: sprite tweaker $190F by sprite number
summary: One byte per sprite number $00-$C8; copied into RAM_Tweaker190F,X. Misc flags (e.g. wall/ledge handling, cape and silver-coin behaviour).

ZeroSpriteTables.name: Clear per-sprite state tables
summary: Zeroes the sprite state, timers, speeds, direction and miscellaneous per-slot tables for sprite slot X, then sets the offscreen-horizontal flag to 1.
Parameters: X = sprite slot. Does not clear sprite number, position or status.

LoadSpriteTables.name: Load sprite palette and tweaker bytes
summary: Sets RAM_SpritePal,X from the low nibble of the sprite's $166E tweaker value, then calls LoadTweakerBytes.
Parameters: X = sprite slot (sprite number already in RAM_SpriteNum,X). Preserves X and Y.

LoadTweakerBytes.name: Copy tweaker bytes into sprite slot
summary: Copies the six tweaker bytes of the slot's sprite number from the Sprite*Vals tables into $1656/$1662/$166E/$167A/$1686/$190F,X.
Parameters: X = sprite slot. Preserves X and Y.

InitSpriteTables.name: Initialise sprite slot tables
summary: Runs ZeroSpriteTables then LoadSpriteTables for sprite slot X.

CircleCoords.name: Sine table and line-guide path data
summary: $07F7DB-$07F9DA: 256 16-bit sine/cosine values (sin x 256) for angles 0-255 over half a circle; index with [angle]*2.
$07F9DB-$07FBF2: 32 packed paths (probably 4-bit X/Y positions) for line-guided sprites; pointers in the low/high tables at $07FBF3/$07FC13.
$07FC33-$07FC8F: speed tables and routine that spawns four spin-jump stars (extended sprite $10) at the current sprite.

lines.07F24E: Tile numbers $66,$66,$6E, then $FF terminator; indexed by [X]/4 (see CODE_07F226)
lines.07F259: A = entry from the shared value table at $07F1AA (starts 01,02,03... = score sprite numbers)
lines.07F25D: $1900 = that value (read by the score/points handling)
lines.07F267: Give points for that score value
lines.07F787: Offscreen horizontal flag = 1 (treated as off screen until processed)
lines.07F790: A = tweaker byte $166E for that sprite type
lines.07F794: Keep low nibble: palette bits and graphics page bit
lines.07F79A: Copy all tweaker bytes into the slot
lines.07F7A3: X = sprite number of slot Y
lines.07F7D2: Clear the per-sprite RAM tables of slot X
lines.07F7D6: Load palette and tweaker bytes for slot X
lines.07FC33: Spin star X speeds for stars 0-3: -$20, +$20, -$20, +$20
lines.07FC37: Spin star Y speeds for stars 0-3: -$10, -$10, +$10, +$10
lines.07FC49: Look for a free extended sprite slot
lines.07FC60: / Star Y low = sprite Y low + 4
lines.07FC68: / Star Y high = sprite Y high + carry
lines.07FC70: / Star X low = sprite X low + 4
lines.07FC78: / Star X high = sprite X high + carry
lines.07FC80: / Star X speed from table by star index
lines.07FC87: / Star Y speed from table by star index
lines.07FBF3: Line-guide path 0-7: low bytes of path pointers
lines.07FBFB: Line-guide path 8-15: low bytes of path pointers
lines.07FC03: Line-guide path 16-23: low bytes of path pointers
lines.07FC0B: Line-guide path 24-31: low bytes of path pointers
lines.07FC13: Line-guide path 0-7: high bytes of path pointers
lines.07FC1B: Line-guide path 8-15: high bytes of path pointers
lines.07FC23: Line-guide path 16-23: high bytes of path pointers
lines.07FC2B: Line-guide path 24-31: high bytes of path pointers
